facts.fact: CNDP president Omar Seghrouchni circulated a letter to national media on 2 June 2025 asking them to notify and seek authorisations to align their personal data processing with Law 09-08 before 31 July 2025.
The CNDP, headed by president Omar Seghrouchni, was acting in June 2025 by writing to media outlets to comply with Law 09-08.
